units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:14">Y. Taan. IV, 69ᵃ</cite> <he>ארכינטס וב׳</he> (corr. acc.) archont or senator; v. <cite ref="B00258"><he>בּוּלֶבְטֵס</he></cite>.—Pl. <cite ref="B00256"><he>בּוּלְבּוּטֵי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Gittin 36b">Gitt. 36ᵇ</cite> sq. (explain. <he>פרוסבול</he>) <he>פרוס בולי ובוטי</he> (prob. a Babyl. corruption of <he>בולי בולבוטי</he> πρὸς βουλῇ βουλευτῶν) before the council of senators.
<cite ref="Gittin 37a">Ib. 37ᵃ</cite> (as if two words) <he>בולי ובו׳ וכ׳</he> bulé are the rich, bute (as if fr. <cite ref="B00502"><he>בטט</he></cite>, play on <he>עבט</he>) the poor (broken ones).
